lifecycle.admission: Cancellation, existing operation/suspension/joining slots, active foreground workspace/presentation, exact client/account/Space UTF-8 and actual session identity are required.
lifecycle.reservation: A non-cancellable completion wait is installed in the existing operation slot before the first suspension. The typed worker and tracker are each fixed one-per-call.
lifecycle.nativeAuthority: The callback runs inside the unchanged actual AnyApplicationSession.perform and receives that exact AnyHostLease; neither this UI fence nor the source archive replaces native authorization.
lifecycle.cancellation: Caller cancellation cancels the typed worker. Existing suspend cancels the same operation slot; its tracker forwards cancellation to that worker but continues waiting for public terminal completion.
lifecycle.failure: Callback, session validation and identity errors are thrown to the caller, not swallowed or converted to a successful UI operation.
lifecycle.delivery: After the last await, the MainActor checks caller cancellation, epoch, foreground/start/suspension, workspace session identity, exact presentation lifetime and expected account/Space before return.
lifecycle.drain: Public-method defer clears its occupied slot, conditionally clears busy for its epoch, and signals completion synchronously. The public method never awaits its own drain tracker, preventing a result/drain cycle.
lifecycle.originalPaths: Existing resume, execute, join, closeWorkspace, signOut and suspend bodies remain byte-identical; they already refuse another operation or cancel/drain the occupied slot.
lifecycle.package: Only the unified EngineHost branch gains the real PinkhaAnyEngine package/product dependency needed by AnyHTTPClient. The preserved Heart-only branch stays empty and its facade stays conditionally excluded.
